title: EF Core Loading & N+1 Problem Explained

scenes.line1: How does loading data affect speed?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why your app slows down when loading related data? Let's see which loading method keeps things fast.

scenes.label: Eager
scenes.sub: Fetches related data up front using Include.
scenes.say: Eager loading grabs all related data in one go, using the Include method.
You can load related data eagerly, lazily, or explicitly. Each has its own pros and cons.
Eager loading uses one query for everything. Lazy loading can trigger lots of small queries, causing the N plus one problem.

scenes.question: How do you avoid N+1 in EF Core?
scenes.right: Use eager loading with Include to fetch related data in one query.
scenes.say: Here's a classic interview trap: Avoiding N plus one isn't about using lazy loading everywhere. You want eager loading with Include to grab all data together.
